name: Atavistic Will
body:
Your ancestral rage protects you from psychic domination.

Prerequisite(s): Atavistic avatar class ability, 12th-level bloodrager.

Benefit(s): Once per day while in a bloodrage, when you fail a saving throw against a mind-affecting effect, you can delay the effect’s onset until the end of your bloodrage. You lose your bonuses from Skill Focus granted by the atavistic avatar ability while the effect is delayed.

Special: This feat counts as the shared consciousness class ability for the purpose of prerequisites.
